relevance_note: Letter describing one patient with Blau syndrome and somatic mosaic NOD2 p.Arg334Gln: "We identified a 17-year-old patient with a clinical diagnosis of BS".
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short script, values typed from reading. No supplementary material in the file; the clinical description and Table E1 are in the Online Repository, not available. Individuals: the index patient (female, from 'the patient and her family'), father and mother (Table I; tested negative, WT/WT and 0% mutated allele), and the 'Germline mutation' row of Table I, a separate BS patient with a germline p.Arg334Gln used as a positive control (Fig 1 C), labelled by the table's Individual column. Patient variant recorded as mosaic (somatic mosaicism, 4.9%-11.0% across blood, sorted cells, mucosal swab, urine, skin); de novo because both parents tested negative. The heterozygous c.802C>T (rs2066842) is a common polymorphism the authors use only as an amplification check; no row. Control patient zygosity 'heterozygous' read from the genotype notation 'p.Arg334Gln/WT'. Statement that the patient's phenotype 'resembles that detected in patients with BS affected exclusively with the triad' was not used to mark dermatitis or uveitis observed (not explicit). 'No joint deformities' was not used to exclude camptodactyly. Parents' pedigree is only in Fig 1 A; no phenotype recorded for them. No contradictions found.
